name: Axal
long_description:
We help companies get custom PCBs built without having to manage multiple vendors themselves. We review or create PCB designs, find the right manufacturer, coordinate production, inspect and test every board, handle any manufacturing issues, and deliver the finished boards directly to your office.

Our goal is to reduce manufacturing errors, shorten iteration cycles, and get your boards to you as quickly as possible without compromising on quality.
one_liner: We design, assemble, and test custom PCBs fast.

launches.title: Axal: Designing and Getting PCB's in China is Dead
launches.tagline: We help companies design and assemble their board in days
launches.body:
We are launching Axal, a services company that designs, assembles, and tests custom PCBs for hardware startups in days. American manufacturing is back. 🇺🇸

Axal enables hardware teams to get custom PCBs designed and built in the U.S. without needing electrical engineers on staff.

We’ve helped teams go from no PCB design to a working board delivered in as little as two weeks.

It’s ridiculous that American hardware startups have to go overseas just to get a PCB designed and built affordably. Together, we can change that and build more hardware in America.

launches.title: Axal: Legacy Code, Understood in Hours. Seriously.
launches.tagline: We help startups who want to integrate their tech into enterprise legacy systems by expediting the process of discovery + rewrite by months.
launches.body:
Hi, we’re Samai and Nand — Co-Founders of Axal 👋

If you're selling to a sticky product to enterprises, you've probably run into this:

“We’d love to use your product, but our stack is too old...”

That’s where we come in.

Axal reverse engineers legacy codebases (Java, C#) to generate **functional requirements and user stories in hours** — essentially helping your clients expedite the discovery process of their modernization. A beta version of our tool then figures out what needs to be rewritten and makes an outline for your team so you can easily rewrite their code and integrate your product. 

MongoDB already does this to land enterprise deals — they rewrite the client’s legacy system _just enough_ to make it so they can integrate their product and switch up the DB. Then they are sticky forever.

Get setup in less than 1 hour guaranteed. 

Axal Demo - Creating Functional Requirement Document and User story of 30k line Java codebase 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yXWTFxfw2vE

We make that process instant and repeatable so if you have a sticky product you can integrate with enterprise codebases easily.

**Why it matters to you (YC founder):**

You’re not just selling software. You’re selling _change_.

If legacy tech is blocking your deal, let us unblock it — so you can close faster and look like a hero.

To get started, email me - [samai@joinaxal.com](mailto:samai@joinaxal.com)

launches.title: Axal - Automate identifying and fixing architectural tech debt
launches.tagline: Break down monoliths, identify tech debt, and fix it with AI at scale!
launches.body:
Hey everyone, I’m Nand - Founder at Axal👋\
\
We built a tool that uses deterministic methods to **automate the hardest parts of application modernization**— identifying architectural bottlenecks and prioritizing those issues based on business value. Once the issues are broken down by Axal, AI can autonomously collaborate with your team to resolve them.

# **The Problem**

Everyone knows that software teams cut corners in development over time, resulting in accumulation of debt tech overtime that slows them down and raises costs. Until now, to address this problem there needed to be long modernization efforts, where stakeholders spent months finding possible solutions to the problem, if you could even find and train the team members needed to do the work. 

# **Our Solution: One platform for Application Modernization**

Axal uses deterministic methods to provide teams with clear observability into architectural technical debt.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/5453ac1a-0928-4ba2-91f1-665ad2c142fd)

We show tech debt scores tailored to your goals. For example, if maintainability is your focus, we display the maintainability index, aligning business impact with priorities to guide effective action.

Technical teams can leverage our graphs to gain clear insights into class-level and domain-level codebase relationships.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/ceaeb77c-b33c-4ef2-8540-3e5fc5f564d2)

Architectural issues - domain exclusivity, circular dependencies, dead code, etc. - are automatically detected based on the goals that an organization makes, and engineers can work with Axal to assign their priority.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/f63d172c-c479-4a22-92b6-ab40ffdd2ef7)

Once prioritized, **Axal leverages AI to autonomously address issues**, while ensuring none of the existing code breaks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/01d79606-ac19-4fd4-a503-aff34a23a9c8)

**Demo Video** (\* excludes technical debt scores and AI code fix demonstration)

<https://youtu.be/4WAwWXrpAGU>

# **Our Ask**

Please reach out:

\- If you want to see your team's architectural technical debt 

\- If you have a Java, C#, or Go monolithic application you want to modernize, contact us (min. 100k lines of code)

Please let us know if you have any previous connections to large to medium-sized companies undergoing application modernization

Learn more at [axal.ai](http://axal.ai)
